entries.note: Jensen 2008 (PMID 18430202, epub 2008-04-22) quote verbatim in abstract. Luminespib iv, HER2 BT-474, biomarker_selected match; opener 2008. Track post-dates tanespimycin HSP70 induction in patients (Banerji 2005), so retrodiction should be true.

entries.rule: DRAFTER_BRIEF retrodiction: an engagement model first public after a patient result on the same target, member or not, is a retrodiction; reproduced is retro, never same
entries.note: Jhaveri 2012 (PMID 22781552, epub 2012-07-10) quote verbatim in abstract. Alvespimycin iv with trastuzumab, HER2-selected correct. HSP70 rose in tanespimycin-dosed patients (Banerji 2005; Modi 2007) before the 2008 xenograft: retro, retrodiction true.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule: engagement is a target claim; tanespimycin patients showed HSP70 induction (Banerji 2005) before the 2008 xenograft readout, so reproducing it in alvespimycin patients is retro, never same; retrodiction should be true.

entries.note: Modi 2013 (PMID 23580070, epub 2013-04-12; NCT00817362 no posted results) quote verbatim. Retaspimycin iv with trastuzumab, HER2-selected, single-arm Simon design in note; 0/26 responses, contra on primary endpoint.

entries.rule: DRAFTER_BRIEF efficacy: scored on the trial's primary endpoint; population_group codes the patients compared
entries.note: Jhaveri 2014 (PMID 24512858, epub 2013-12-28) quote verbatim. Ganetespib iv correct; status contra holds (Simon stage 1 missed, 0 TNBC RECIST responses). Primary ORR is over 22 unselected patients: population_group should be unselected, not biomarker_selected.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy rule, single-arm with preset Simon bar: stage 1 missed, no TNBC RECIST response, so contra stands. Primary ORR was over 22 unselected patients; population_group should read unselected.

entries.rule: CHECKER_BRIEF 3 first bullet: trial attributes the result to conditions the model never tested; the combination exception covers the partner drug, not the population
entries.note: Grinshpun 2026 (PMID 42873573) quote verbatim; NCT01560416 results posted 2019-01-03, year right. Ganetespib iv plus fulvestrant correct. Authors attribute the null to established endocrine resistance (ESR1, proliferative programs), never modelled in MCF-7; untested_reason not_measured already set.
entries.adjudication_note: Checker brief 3, first bullet: Grinshpun abstract attributes the null to established endocrine resistance (ESR1 alterations, proliferative programs), never modelled in endocrine-sensitive MCF-7. Combination exception covers fulvestrant, not population. untested_reason not_measured stands.

entries.note: Ying 2012 (PMID 22144665, epub 2011-12-05) quote verbatim in abstract; title claims superior safety profile. Ganetespib iv, unselected; opener 2011.

entries.rule: DRAFTER_BRIEF safety: the stated prediction must hold and its silence must not be contradicted on a harm the species could have shown
entries.note: Jhaveri 2014 quote verbatim; ganetespib iv, unselected correct. The cardiac/liver claim held, but the passing-tolerability ruling scores the claim without excusing silence: diarrhoea, rodent-showable (Glaze rats), was commonest (97% in Grinshpun).
entries.adjudication_note: Safety rule: silence contradicted on a harm the species could show is a miss even when the stated cardiac/liver claim held (as CML ABL1 safety 1, PBC FXR safety 3). Diarrhoea, rodent-showable, was commonest in 2013 breast patients.

entries.rule: DRAFTER_BRIEF retrodiction for safety: the same drug's own earlier patient result; reproduced is retro
entries.note: Zhou 2013 (PMID 24090817, epub 2013-10-01) quote verbatim; abstract cites NVP-AUY922's prior clinical visual disorders, so luminespib's own earlier result makes it retro. Luminespib iv correct; per-drug split correct.

entries.note: Gaykema 2014 (PMID 25085789) quote verbatim in abstract. Luminespib 70 mg/m2 weekly iv, HER2-positive lesions analysed, biomarker_selected fits; no earlier patient HER2-PET loss under HSP90 inhibition found, so prospective.

entries.note: Glaze 2005 (PMID 15986212) MTD/start-dose quote verbatim in abstract. Alvespimycin iv (one dog cohort oral; patients iv), unselected acceptable for an animal opener; states no effective exposure.

entries.rule: DRAFTER_BRIEF dose table row 1 and decision 16: no stated exposure target or tolerability margin above an effective exposure is untested; an MTD is not a target
entries.note: Jhaveri 2012 RP2D quote verbatim. Glaze states daily-x5 species MTDs and a start dose, no effective exposure or margin; weekly human MTD 80 mg/m2 hits no model target. Entry's own untested_reason no_prediction contradicts same.
entries.adjudication_note: Dose table row 1, decision 16: an MTD is not a target and a margin is a tolerated dose at or above a stated effective exposure; Glaze stated none. Untested, untested_reason no_prediction (already on the entry).

entries.note: Leow 2009 (PMID 19671750, epub 2009-08-11) quote verbatim. Retaspimycin with trastuzumab, iv, HER2 match; opener 2009. Post-dates Modi 2007 tanespimycin-trastuzumab responses: retrodiction should be true.

entries.note: Friedland 2014 quote verbatim (epub 2013-05-18), MDA-MB-231 named. Ganetespib iv, TNBC xenograft biomarker_selected; ganetespib track opener 2013 correct.

missing: Alvespimycin rat/dog toxicology, Glaze 2005 (10.1007/s00280-005-1000-9, PMID 15986212, epub 2005-06-29): prospective; predicted GI, marrow, hepatic (both species), renal and gallbladder (dog), stated MTDs and a phase 1 starting dose. Breast patients (Jhaveri 2012, 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-11-3200): DLTs were grade III LV systolic dysfunction and reversible grade III keratitis, harms a dog study could show and the model was silent on; renal/gallbladder harms never appeared. Needs its own safety (and dose, margin_stated) track.

ER-positive xenograft model of resistance emergence, Whitesell 2014 (10.1073/pnas.1421323111, PMID 25489079, epub 2014-12-08): sub-growth-inhibitory ganetespib had 'no overt anticancer activity on its own' but 'dramatically impaired the emergence of resistance to hormone antagonists' in mice. Grinshpun 2026 names it as the fulvestrant trial's direct preclinical rationale; the trial tested established resistance, so the emergence prediction is untested and the no-activity-alone statement is consistent with the null. Own track.

ENCHANT-1 (NCT01677455) interim results, Synta press release 2013-12-12 (SEC exhibit 99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1157601/000110465913090265/a13-26324_1ex99d1.htm): first-line ganetespib monotherapy, HER2+ cohort 3 of 4 evaluable objective responses (1 CR), TNBC cohort 2 of 11 PR (18%) and 5 SD; AEs diarrhoea, fatigue, nausea. Tier 5, trial_unreported; registry completed 2015-08 with no results. Belongs in patient_trials of the HER2 and TNBC tracks and bears on efficacy #4.

Ganetespib first-in-human phase 1, Goldman 2013 (10.1186/1471-2407-13-152, PMID 23530663, epub 2013-03-25): plasma HSP70 elevated over a week post dose (engagement, downstream, mixed solid tumours), linear PK, MTD 216 mg/m2, RP2D 200 mg/m2, DLT grade 3 diarrhoea. A patient-side dose and engagement source for the ganetespib tracks the draft does not use.

No patient-derived xenograft or organoid comparison with patient response was found for any member in breast cancer (WebSearch). Jensen 2008 ran patient-derived primary breast tumour clonogenic assays (MAXF lines) for luminespib GI50 but never compared them with patients, so no track is owed.

Tanespimycin patient results that pre-date the HER2 xenograft system (April 2008): HSP70 induction in patient PBL and tumour (Banerji 2005, 10.1200/JCO.2005.00.612) and HSP70 plus HER2-positive breast regressions with trastuzumab (Modi 2007, 10.1200/JCO.2007.11.7960). The her2-breast-xenograft engagement and efficacy tracks are retrodictions.
Lint finding on the current draft: efficacy retaspimycin track of her2-breast-xenograft is out of year order (efficacy 8, 2009, follows efficacy 2, 2013).
rule_questions: Dose: when the trial reports human PK but neither trial nor model source compares it with the model's effective exposure, and the trial itself suspects underdosing (Modi 2013), is dose 'contra derived_from efficacy' (drafter) or 'untested' (checker), and does efficacy stay 'contra' in that case?

Efficacy, patient-level track: when the model's prediction is for a subgroup (TNBC) of a trial whose primary endpoint failed over the unselected population and the subgroup size is unreported, is the subgroup scored (contra), or does the track wait for a trial with that subgroup as its primary population? Can a tier-5 interim press release (ENCHANT-1 TNBC 2/11 PR) set a 'same'/partial on that track?

Safety: when the model's stated prediction held (no cardiac or liver toxicity) but its silence was contradicted on another harm the species could show (diarrhoea), does the track net to 'contra', or does the held prediction stand as 'same' with the silence noted? The v3 safety definition asks both questions but does not say how they combine on one track.

Efficacy: the trial was designed on the model (Grinshpun 2026 cites Friedland 2014) yet attributes its null to the population's defining condition (established endocrine resistance) that the model never represented. Does the brief's 'conditions the model never tested' pattern give 'untested', or does reliance on the model for exactly this question keep 'contra'?

Dose, decision 16: is a toxicology package that states MTDs and a safety-factor phase 1 start, but names no effective exposure, a 'stated margin' (drafter: margin_stated true, same) or no margin (checker: untested)? Alvespimycin dose #4; the trial also never bridged its PK to any animal exposure.

Safety 2 (re-raised): the 'passing tolerability claim is scored' ruling decides that Ying 2012 is a prediction, not how a held stated prediction combines with contradicted silence (diarrhoea) on one track. Resolve with NSCLC HSP90 safety 2.

Rule 6 says every cell opens untested, while the retrodiction rule says a post-dating model that reproduced the human data is retro: does a retrodictive track open untested (with retrodiction true) or retro?
